name: arcanos_gaming_query
title: arcanos gaming query
description: Ask ARCANOS for gameplay guide, build or meta guidance with player progress and spoiler constraints. May use providers and bounded public sources. Does not save sources or player progress.

name: arcanos_gaming_canary
title: arcanos gaming canary
description: Check the fixed public Gaming pipeline fixture. Does not call providers or inspect infrastructure; success does not prove live generation or storage.

name: arcanos_gaming_hybrid_query
title: arcanos gaming hybrid query
description: Query stored Gaming evidence and start a bounded, temporary owner workflow. Normal guide/build/meta traffic selects released gaming-hybrid-v2; explicit v1 is legacy-compatible. For v2 clarify, repeat the original query with resolved context, returned workflowId and expectedRevision, and a new operation key; accepted evidence and budgets persist. Preserve state, nextAction, freshness and provenance. No durable source storage.

idempotencyKey.description: New key per logical operation; reuse only for identical retries. Bound to the authenticated caller.

expectedRevision.description: V2 clarification continuation only; pair with workflowId and the returned revision.

name: arcanos_gaming_submit_candidates
title: arcanos gaming submit candidates
description: Independently acquire up to three candidate public URLs per backend-granted submission in the same owned workflow. Released v2 permits one bounded recovery with the returned expectedRevision; explicit v1 permits one gameplay submission. Frontend hints never approve evidence. May fetch sources and generate a grounded answer. Retains temporary evidence only; never stores sources durably.

idempotencyKey.description: New key per logical operation; reuse only for identical retries. Bound to the authenticated caller.

discoveryType.description: Optional operation role. Omit for legacy calls; the backend infers only its pending operation and enforces separate one-shot budgets.

expectedRevision.description: Required only for v2. Must equal the current backend workflow revision; never inferred or advanced by the frontend.

name: arcanos_gaming_ingestion_status
title: arcanos gaming ingestion status
description: Read the sanitized status and per-source outcomes for this OAuth owner's Gaming ingestion. At most three polls per interaction. Legacy Action jobs are not accessible.

name: arcanos_gaming_ingest_sources
title: arcanos gaming ingest sources
description: Durably ingest up to four explicitly requested public Gaming source URLs. Requires separate write permission, explicit storage policy, confirmStore=true and a stable idempotency key. Poll status after acceptance.

sourceTypeHint.description: Untrusted classification hint; ARCANOS determines the stored source type.

name: arcanos_gaming_refresh_sources
title: arcanos gaming refresh sources
description: Refresh up to four known sources in the private owner's Gaming corpus. Changes stored revisions. Requires separate write permission, storage policy, confirmStore=true and a stable idempotency key.

name: arcanos_gaming_ingest_candidates
title: arcanos gaming ingest candidates
description: Durably ingest selected backend-approved candidates from this owned workflow. Requires separate write permission, matching storage policy, confirmStore=true and a stable idempotency key. Candidate approval and eligibility are checked again.

idempotencyKey.description: New key per logical operation; reuse only for identical retries. Bound to the authenticated caller.
